page.overview:
Who is Wild Bill?

Wild Bill was an Army helicopter pilot who worked for Flint during his pursuit of the Joes.

He was seen riding in his attack and transport helicopter trying to apprehend the Joes under Flint's orders. Category:Renegades Characters
